_why: One list for both gates. A pull request needs the branch checks green to merge (the main ruleset), and release.yml refuses to build a tagged commit until the release checks passed on it (tools/release-gate.mjs). Names are check-run names as GitHub shows them, which for a job with a name: is that name, not the job key. pullRequestOnly lists checks that exist only on a pull request, so a tagged commit on main is not expected to have them.
